types.title: Contact
types.description: A person or organization in an address book.

types.title: Contact note
types.description: A user-authored note attached to a contact.

types.title: Contact tag
types.description: A book-scoped label assigned to contacts.

queries.title: List manual address books
queries.description: List manual address books the current actor may read, including effective permissions for choosing action targets.

query.description: Optional address-book name or description search.

minimumPermission.description: Minimum effective permission required for each returned address book.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

queries.title: Get contact
queries.description: Read one contact by stable UUID after resolving and checking its owning address book.

queries.title: List contacts
queries.description: List contacts in one already selected readable address book with bounded filters, opaque pagination, and navigable contact cards.

bookId.description: Address-book UUID, or "system" for the read-only system address book.

query.description: Optional text matched against contact fields.

tagIds.description: Only contacts having at least one of these book-scoped tags.

favoritesOnly.description: Only contacts favorited by the current user.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Resolve contacts by email
queries.description: Resolve up to 100 known exact email addresses to every readable matching contact with bounded contact details.

emails.description: Normalized email addresses to resolve to every readable matching contact.

contactIds.description: Optional contact UUIDs that further restrict the matches.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of exact contact matches to return.

queries.title: Search contacts
queries.description: Find, show, or open permission-filtered contacts by name, email, phone, or address-book facet. Returns navigable contact cards.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

tags.title: Phone
tags.description: Show contacts that have a phone number.

tags.title: Email
tags.description: Show contacts that have an email address.

queries.title: Suggest contacts
queries.description: Autocomplete readable email recipients while composing mail by matching names, organizations, email addresses, phone numbers, and addresses.

query.description: Text matched against readable contact names, organizations, email addresses, phone numbers, and addresses.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of contact suggestions to return.

queries.title: List contact notes
queries.description: List notes for one readable contact, newest first.

contactId.description: Contact whose notes should be listed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

queries.title: List contact tags
queries.description: List the bounded tag vocabulary for one readable address book.

bookId.description: Address-book UUID whose tags should be listed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

actions.title: Create contact
actions.description: Create one contact in an explicitly selected writable address book.

bookId.description: Address-book UUID that will own the contact.

parentContactId.description: Optional parent contact in the same book.

tagIds.description: Complete replacement set of book-scoped tag UUIDs.

emails.description: Complete replacement set of email addresses.

phones.description: Complete replacement set of phone numbers.

addresses.description: Complete replacement set of postal addresses.

bankAccounts.description: Complete replacement set of bank accounts.

actions.title: Delete contact
actions.description: Permanently delete one manual contact after an optimistic version check.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt value returned by the last read; prevents stale deletion.

actions.title: Move contact
actions.description: Move a contact to another writable book. Book-scoped tags and hierarchy links are removed.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt value returned by the last read; prevents stale moves.

actions.title: Update contact
actions.description: Update selected contact fields; provided collection fields replace their current values.

expectedUpdatedAt.description: updatedAt value returned by the last read; prevents lost updates.

parentContactId.description: Optional parent contact in the same book.

tagIds.description: Complete replacement set of book-scoped tag UUIDs.

emails.description: Complete replacement set of email addresses.

phones.description: Complete replacement set of phone numbers.

addresses.description: Complete replacement set of postal addresses.

bankAccounts.description: Complete replacement set of bank accounts.

actions.title: Set contact favorite
actions.description: Set or clear the current user's favorite state for one readable contact.

favorite.description: Desired favorite state for the current user.

actions.title: Create contact note
actions.description: Append a user-authored note to one writable contact exactly once.

contactId.description: Stable contact UUID that will own the note.

actions.title: Change contact tags
actions.description: Atomically add and remove book-scoped tags on one writable contact.

contactId.description: Stable contact UUID whose tags should change.
